researcher: claude, from memory of the vendor docs; the docs site is script-rendered and was not fetched for this sheet (0.22.0, trust_ca route)

facts.claim: On a UniFi OS console the Network integration API is served under /proxy/network/integration on the console's own address; the host here is a placeholder (.invalid never resolves) that the owner replaces with --base-url.
facts.evidence: Path from memory; the host is deliberately a reserved name (RFC 6761), not a fact about the service.

facts.claim: A request carries the controller's API key in the X-API-KEY header.
facts.evidence: From memory; the page text was not fetched.

facts.claim: The key is sent as a request header, not as a bearer token.
facts.evidence: From memory; the page text was not fetched.

facts.claim: The template pins only its placeholder host; add-http pins the host of the --base-url the owner gives, and nothing else is called.
facts.evidence: A placeholder by design; the pinning behaviour is LOTR's own (add-http).

facts.claim: Reads: GET /v1/info, /v1/sites, /v1/sites/{siteId}/devices and /v1/sites/{siteId}/clients return the application version, sites, adopted devices and connected clients.
facts.evidence: From memory of the API reference.

facts.claim: Changes are POSTs and DELETEs: device and port actions (restart, power-cycle), client actions (authorize guest access) and hotspot vouchers.
facts.evidence: From memory of the API reference.

facts.claim: The key is created in the UniFi Network application on the controller itself (its integrations settings) and is not a unifi.ui.com Site Manager key.
facts.evidence: From memory; the settings path differs between application versions.

choices.because: read-mostly is the point (site, device and client state); restarting a device or letting a guest on should never be silent

choices.decision: reach the controller over https with the owner's private CA (trust_ca), never plain http and never a disabled check
choices.because: a controller on a private address has no publicly trusted certificate; gt-lotr 0.5.1 trusts the owner's own CA for this one connection and refuses plain http off this machine

choices.decision: the base URL host is a reserved .invalid placeholder
choices.because: every controller has its own address; a placeholder that never resolves means a forgotten --base-url fails closed instead of reaching some other host

open: Nothing here is confirmed from the vendor's docs; read the reference before a live check.
Not tried against a real controller: whether a UniFi OS console accepts an uploaded certificate from a private CA, and where, is not recorded here.
Older self-hosted UniFi Network Application installs (not UniFi OS) may serve the API without the /proxy/network prefix; not checked.
Rate limits and paging parameters (offset, limit) are not recorded.
